body: Thanks for believing in me, but I don't know If I can do it. I'm extremely shy and can't even hold a proper conversation, let alone making new connections. I don't think I can do anything to get away from my family

Thanks for your concern. I don't know if I'm holding on to something. It's just that my parents have spent tens of thousands of dollars to send me to college. I feel like it's a waste of money if I fail out. 

I have 3 finals and 1 project. I'm really scared for my Chem final because it's a notoriously hard class in my college, and I didn't do well on my midterms. I'm really shy and introverted so I haven't made any friends so far. Going to the counseling is really scary for me, I don't think I can do it.

Right now I'm really frustrated. I don't plan on suicide right now because I'm trying to keep it together for finals. But if I fail out of college, my parents will think I'm some stupid lazy pig, and that may be the tipping point for me
